session_summary: Blue title bar stack: 'Strong Bear Trend From The Open / Outside Down Day / Major Trend Reversal from Double/Triple Bottom'. Reading: double top at the 4155 open, always-in-short sell-off (do-not-buy advice rows, bull traps on each minor pullback rally), consecutive falling wedges, parabolic wedge sell climax at 4116 (below yesterday's 4119 low) though the trend still ground to a 4110 low at 02:15 behind a low-2 signal and a tight bear channel, then a double & triple bottom at 4110 flipped the regime: major trend reversal up, small pullback bull trend through the day midpoint (dotted 4134) to 4140 into the close.
